visual_identity.core_identity: A small vicious rooster-reptile hybrid combining a cock's head and comb with leathery wings, clawed feet, and a serpentine tail.
visual_identity.silhouette: Compact birdlike body, raised leathery wings, rooster head with comb, two clawed legs, long curling reptilian tail.
visual_identity.head_features: Rooster-like head with hooked beak, prominent comb and wattles, fierce eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Small feathered torso transitioning into leathery wings and a scaled curling tail.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Two clawed birdlike legs and one pair of leathery wings; long reptilian tail. No extra quadruped legs.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse feathers on torso, smooth wing membranes, simple tail scales.

accuracy_checks: wings differ from ordinary bird wings

known_failure_modes.correction: restore leathery wings, reptilian tail, and monstrous predatory proportions
restore two birdlike legs, rooster head, and hybrid body
use fierce eyes, hooked beak, and predatory posture

scene_identity.size_impression: Small compact hybrid, clearly smaller than humanoids and furniture while remaining dangerous.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Grounded on two clawed legs or flying with a believable perch/launch relationship.
behavior_style: flapping from a grounded launch point
